# Native run

Owned synthetic Account custom external-ID probe, fresh 30-day Developer scratch org, 2026-11-08. The key field was granted by an assigned permission set; the optional text field was not granted and is not set in these control cases. API 62.0 and 67.0 source versions were deployed separately; sf apex run test --synchronous ran ExtProbeTest for each. The method deliberately fails an assertion to transport observations, not as a passing-test claim. org.tsv records the 12 complete control observations per API. The full API 67 assertion message was truncated, so other cases are excluded. The org was deleted; deletion was verified.
